chapter: Wooden Joe's band and Sidney Correa
title: Pinchback, a teacher who could not play, and playing fast for white dancers
summary: Vincent talks about Pinchback as a teacher who could not execute the instrument. He says white dancers once wanted fast music, and mentions Isaiah Morgan and Tranchina's 400-pound frame.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets
